thread:
maya: Quick async check-in — Genica renewal is tomorrow but they just reported staging webhooks returning 500s. Putting this here so CS/Eng can coordinate. Error started ~03:10 PDT.
ethan: ugh. thanks for flagging. do we have any request ids or stack traces? could be LB or runtime.
sophie: pulling logs now. initial look shows 502/504 from upstream between 03:10-03:18, but also some 500s with model runtime trace: \`runtime/error: kv-cache miss -> goroutine panic\`. grabbing request ids.
ravi: thanks @sophie — can you paste one request id here? i'll grep logs for batching/caching signals and check if the new quantized variant rollout touched this customer.
sophie: example request id: 0a1b2c3d-req-4421. curl from their staging webhook: 
```
curl -v -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://staging.api.redwood.ai/genica/webhook
* Connected to staging.api.redwood.ai
< HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
< X-Request-Id: 0a1b2c3d-req-4421
```
logs show `panic: nil pointer` inside batcher.Flush() call.
ravi: seeing the same in infra logs. Batcher triggered flush for seq_len=2048 odd spike. Looks like an edge-case when prefix cache is empty + async batching enabled. Repro steps local-ish.
ethan: is this related to the rollback we did last week for quantized-1.2? Genica is on pinned model:v23 though.
ravi: model variant pinned -> not the quantized rollout. suspect a cache eviction race introduced by 2.0 runtime change. I'm going to run a quick hotfix branch to add a nil-check and guard before Flush(). If tests pass i'll push to staging.
maya: ETA on the hotfix? Customer is on the renewal call tomorrow morning, we need either a mitigation or clear postmortem for them.
ravi: aiming for a staging deploy in ~40m. will coordinate with @deploy-bot for canary.
deploy-bot: ci/pipeline #7421 passed. canary queued for staging pool a1.
sophie: i'll continue collecting any other failing request ids and confirm whether the errors are only on long-sequence requests. so far 7 failures, all seq_len >= 1500.
ethan: i'll prep a short note for the renewal thread: explain issue, mitigation plan (hotfix + rollback plan), and propose a 30-min touchpoint in the morning if unresolved.
maya: thanks. if hotfix doesn't land by EOD, we should schedule an emergency patch window before their renewal call. cc: @ravi @sophie @ethan.
ravi: will update here when staging canary is green or if I need help reverting the batching change.
sophie: can confirm canary started at 2013347888 and initial endpoints show reduced 500s. continuing to monitor logs + alerting.
maya: perfect. agree to reconvene in this thread at 2013348050 or earlier. thanks team. :thumbsup:
